title: Social Media Manager
description:
**Social Media Content Creator & Manager (Instagram + TikTok)**



Part-time (with option to grow to full-time) | Long-term role | Work from home



**About the Brand**



We are a new luxury wellness and beauty startup, yet to launch.. Our content is modern, empowering, feminine and aesthetic, designed to inspire confidence and self-expression.



We're looking for a creative content creator who has done this before: someone who has taken a brand's social presence from zero to launch and beyond, and who can help build ours from the ground up using AI tools, short-form video and smart social strategy.



**Role Overview**



You'll create high-quality content for Instagram and TikTok, using AI tools and trend-based ideas to build the brand's presence from day one and grow our following. This includes:



- AI-generated content

- Reels + TikTok videos

- Carousel posts

- Aesthetic graphics

- Trend-based short-form videos

- Caption writing

- Scheduling and posting



**Responsibilities**



- Help shape and execute the brand's social presence from pre-launch through launch and growth

- Create daily/weekly content for Instagram and TikTok

- Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Canva AI, CapCut AI, etc.) to generate ideas and assets

- Edit short-form videos (Reels/TikTok)

- Design branded graphics and carousels

- Write captions in a modern, feminine, empowering tone

- Research trends and apply them to the brand

- Build and maintain a content calendar

- Suggest strategies to increase followers

- Repurpose content across platforms

- Keep all content aligned with the IJB brand identity



**Required Skills & Experience**



- **Proven experience building a brand's social media content from startup to launch** — you've grown a new account from nothing and can show us the results

- Experience creating content for Instagram and TikTok

- Strong skills in Canva and CapCut

- Ability to use AI tools for content creation

- Good eye for design, aesthetics and modern branding

- Strong English writing skills

- Ability to create short-form videos quickly

- Understanding of social media trends

- Ability to work independently



**Bonus Skills (preferred, not required)**



- Experience with beauty, wellness, lifestyle or luxury brands

- Knowledge of Instagram growth strategies

- Ability to create UGC-style videos

- Basic photo retouching

- Experience managing brand accounts



**Salary**



Depending on experience: $4–$8 AUD per hour or $350–$600 AUD/month (part-time). Potential to grow into a full-time role as the brand expands — with the opportunity to head up a growing team.



**How to Apply (IMPORTANT — follow all steps)**



Send the following:



1. Portfolio (Instagram, TikTok, Canva or Google Drive)

2. **An example of a brand account you built from startup/pre-launch, with a brief note on your role and the growth achieved**

3. 3 AI-generated content samples

4. A 30-second video introducing yourself

5. Your expected salary (hourly or monthly)

6. Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link

7. Start your message with **IJB2026** so we know you read the full post



Applications without these requirements will not be considered.



**Why Join Us?**



- Long-term, stable role

- Creative freedom

- Work with a premium, modern brand from day one — and shape it

- Supportive founder

- Opportunity to grow as the brand grows

title: VIDEO EDITOR FOR PODCAST + VIRAL SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT
description:
VIDEO EDITOR FOR PODCAST + VIRAL SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT



???? PAY



$100 USD per completed project



This is NOT an hourly position.



We pay based on completed deliverables, not the number of hours it takes.



If you're efficient, organized, and produce exceptional work, you'll have the opportunity to complete more projects and increase your earnings over time.



Each completed project includes:



• One fully edited podcast episode (typically 1–2 hours in length)

• One mastered audio version

• One full podcast video with captions

• Five high-performing vertical videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

• Up to 2 rounds of revisions (requested within 7 days of delivery)



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term part of our growing media company.





ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for a creative, highly skilled, and reliable video editor who wants to help build a world-class podcast brand.



This is much more than simply cutting footage together.



We are looking for someone who understands storytelling, viewer psychology, pacing, emotion, and how to keep audiences watching until the very end.



You should understand that every second matters.



Every cut.

Every zoom.

Every sound effect.

Every pause.

Every caption.



...should have a purpose.



Our goal is to create some of the highest-quality podcast content on YouTube and social media.





OUR INSPIRATION



One of our biggest inspirations is Diary of a CEO.



Before applying, please watch at least three full episodes and study the editing.



Pay close attention to:



• Opening hooks

• Curiosity gaps

• Open loops

• Emotional storytelling

• Cinematic pacing

• Strategic zooms

• Music placement

• Sound design

• Tension and release

• Retention psychology



We're not looking to copy their style.



We're looking for someone who understands WHY viewers stay engaged.



If you understand the psychology behind great editing, you'll fit in well with our team.





ABOUT OUR BRAND



You will be editing content for Christy Love.



Christy's brand is unlike anyone else's.



She is an:



• Adult entertainer

• Ordained pastor

• Stand-up comedian

• Author

• Podcast host



Her podcast, In Bed with Christy Love, features comedians, actors, entrepreneurs, influencers, adult industry personalities, athletes, and guests with extraordinary life stories.



The show explores conversations most people are afraid to have.



Topics include:



• Success

• Failure

• Faith

• Comedy

• Sex

• Addiction

• Trauma

• Relationships

• Mental health

• Personal growth

• Redemption

• Human psychology



The goal is to make people laugh...



Think...



Feel...



And walk away seeing the world differently.





CURRENT REACH



• 250,000+ followers across social media

• Approximately 8 million monthly views



We are investing heavily into growing this brand over the next several years.



We're looking for people who want to grow with us.





WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



Each week you'll edit approximately:



• 2–3 podcast episodes



Each episode is generally between 1 and 2 hours long.





DELIVERABLES PER PROJECT



Each completed project includes:



• One professionally edited podcast video

• One professionally mastered podcast audio file

• One full podcast video with captions

• Five high-performing vertical videos

• Exported files ready for publishing

• Organized project files (if requested)





RESPONSIBILITIES



You'll be responsible for:



• Editing long-form podcast episodes

• Synchronizing multiple camera angles

• Removing mistakes, interruptions, filler words, and unnecessary dead space

• Improving pacing and overall viewer retention

• Creating compelling opening hooks

• Building curiosity throughout the episode

• Enhancing audio quality

• Balancing audio levels

• Adding intro, commercial, and outro sequences

• Creating engaging captions

• Delivering five viral-ready short-form clips

• Meeting weekly deadlines consistently





VISUAL EDITING REQUIREMENTS



We want every episode to feel polished, cinematic, and premium.



You should be comfortable with:



• Multi-camera editing

• Color correction

• Color grading

• White balance adjustments

• Exposure correction

• Brightness and contrast adjustments

• Skin tone correction

• Image sharpening

• Creating a polished cinematic look





AUDIO EDITING REQUIREMENTS



Audio quality is extremely important.



You should know how to:



• Reduce background noise

• Clean dialogue

• Balance audio levels

• Remove distracting pauses

• Improve clarity

• Deliver professional-quality podcast audio





RETENTION PSYCHOLOGY



This is one of the most important parts of this position.



We aren't looking for someone who simply edits.



We're looking for someone who understands why people continue watching.



You should understand concepts like:



• Retention psychology

• Curiosity loops

• Pattern interrupts

• Open loops

• Emotional storytelling

• Building tension

• Releasing tension

• Watch-time optimization

• Hook creation



You should constantly ask yourself:



"How do I keep the viewer watching another 30 seconds?"





CREATING VIRAL CLIPS



Every podcast should produce five outstanding short-form videos.



We're looking for clips with real viral potential.



You should be able to identify:



• Funny 
nts

• Emotional 
nts

• Vulnerable 
nts

• Shocking statements

• Powerful stories

• Unexpected reactions

• Inspirational advice

• Controversial opinions



The goal is simple:



Make people stop scrolling.





TURNAROUND TIME



We publish multiple episodes every week.



Meeting deadlines is critical.



Expected turnaround:



• Full podcast edit: 48–72 hours

• Five short-form clips: 24–48 hours after podcast approval

• Revisions: Within 24 hours whenever reasonably possible



If you already have multiple clients, that's completely fine.



However, you must have enough availability to consistently meet these deadlines.





REVISIONS



Each project includes:



• Up to 2 rounds of revisions

• Revision requests will be submitted within 7 days of delivery.

• Revisions should be completed within 24 hours whenever reasonably possible.



If additional revisions are requested because of a significant creative change (rather than correcting mistakes), additional compensation may be discussed.





SOFTWARE



Any professional editing software is welcome, including:



• Adobe Premiere Pro

• DaVinci Resolve

• Final Cut Pro

• CapCut

• Or equivalent professional editing software





BONUS SKILLS



These are not required but highly valued:



• Motion graphics

• Sound design

• Advanced color grading

• YouTube optimization

• Viral short-form editing

• Experience editing podcasts similar to Diary of a CEO





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



• Creative

• Detail-oriented

• Reliable

• Communicative

• Self-motivated

• Passionate about storytelling

• Obsessed with creating exceptional content



We're not interested in someone who simply completes tasks.



We're looking for someone who wants to help build something special.





HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



• A short introduction about yourself

• Links to podcast episodes you've edited

• Examples of Reels, TikToks, or Shorts you've created

• Your favorite editing software

• Your internet upload speed

• Your internet download speed

• Your computer processor

• Your computer RAM





PAID EDITING TEST



Finalists will be asked to complete a paid editing test using footage from one of our podcast episodes.



This allows both you and our team to determine if we're the right fit before moving into a long-term working relationship.





APPLICATION FILTER



To confirm you've read this entire posting, please begin the FIRST LINE of your application with the word:



LIPS



Applications that do not include this word will not be considered.





FINAL NOTE



We believe editing is one of the most important parts of storytelling.



Great editing doesn't just make a video look better.



It makes people feel something.



If you're someone who genuinely loves storytelling, understands audience psychology, takes pride in your work, communicates well, meets deadlines, and wants to help build a world-class media brand, we'd love to hear from you.



Please message me on 



If you do not have Instagram, please do not apply.

title: Digital Advertising Strategist
description:

mber who is excited to jump in and virtually be a part of High Speed Media, someone who wants to grow with us as we grow.

Build and refine audience targeting, including custom, lookalike, and interest based audiences

Write and direct ad copy and creative that fits each platform and audience

Optimize landing pages to improve conversion rates and campaign performance

Manage budget pacing and forecasting across accounts to hit spend and performance targets

Analyze performance data continuously and turn insights into clear, actionable optimizations

Run structured A/B tests on creative, copy, audiences, and landing pages

Identify organic content that is already resonating and turn it into paid ad creative

Manage and allocate significant ad spend responsibly across multiple client accounts

Deliver clear, accurate performance reporting to clients and internal tea
mbers

Stay current on platform updates, algorithm changes, and new ad formats





What You Bring

Proven, hands on experience running paid campaigns on Meta, Google, TikTok, and LinkedIn and other digital ad platforms

Deep understanding of e-commerce advertising and how it differs from lead gen or awareness campaigns

Strong grasp of Google Search and Performance Max campaign structure and optimization

Experience building and refining audiences, including retargeting and remarketing

Experience connecting pixels, conversion events, and shopping catalogs across platforms

Experience managing large ad budgets with accountability and precision, including pacing and forecasting

Comfort building campaigns independently, without needing detailed direction at every step

An eye for organic content and an understanding of how it can be repurposed for paid ads once it starts to perform

Experience designing and running A/B tests that lead to real optimization

Strong copywriting and creative direction skills for ad content

Comfort with competitor and market research to shape strategy

Experience with CRM and attribution tools to track performance across the full funnel

Experience with video and UGC style ad content

Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications preferred

Excellent written and spoken English

A seasoned, well rounded background across multiple ad platforms and business types



Who You Are

Excited about the work and genuinely enjoys the challenge of a tough account

Respectful, easy to work with, and a strong communicator with clients and teammates

Detail oriented, nothing slips through the cracks on your watch

Results driven and motivated by outcomes, not just activity

Someone who takes ownership and does not need to be micromanaged



Compensation

$6-$11 per hour, based on experience.



MUST BE WILLING TO WORK MONDAY-THURSDAY DURING 8 AM - 5 PM MOUNTAIN TIME HOURS.

Send your resume along with examples of campaigns you have built and managed, including any results you are proud of. Bonus points for specifics on budgets managed and platforms used.

title: Early childhood teacher -Centre manager
description:
About the Role



Teddingon Bear is seeking a passionate, professional, and highly motivated Early Childhood Teacher / Centre Manager to lead the daily operations of our early learning centre.

Centre Leadership and Operations



* Manage the day-to-day operations of the centre.

* Lead, support, and mentor educators and staff.

* Ensure the centre operates in line with relevant childcare regulations, policies, and quality standards.

* Maintain a safe, welcoming, and professional environment for children, families, and staff.

* Support enrolments, tours, and family enquiries.

* Monitor centre performance, occupancy, staffing, and service quality.



Educational Leadership



* Support the delivery of a high-quality early childhood education program.

* Guide educators in planning, programming, and documentation.

* Ensure children’s learning, wellbeing, and development are supported.

* Promote a positive and inclusive learning environment.



Parent and Community Relationships



* Build strong, friendly, and professional relationships with parents and families.

* Communicate clearly and respectfully with families about their child’s progress and centre updates.

* Create a welcoming experience for new and existing families.

* Handle parent enquiries, feedback, and concerns in a calm and professional manner.

* Represent Teddingon Bear positively in the local community.



Occupancy and Business Performance



* Support strategies to maintain and increase centre occupancy.

* Conduct centre tours and follow up with prospective families.

* Work with management to achieve enrolment and occupancy goals.

* Maintain high standards of customer service to support family retention.



Skills and Attributes



The successful candidate will have:



* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

* A friendly, approachable, and professional manner with parents.

* Leadership experience in an early childhood setting.

* Ability to motivate and manage a team.

* Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.

* A positive attitude and commitment to high-quality care.

* Confidence in building family and community relationships.

* Willingness to travel to Perth as required.



Qualifications and Requirements



* Early Childhood Teaching qualification or relevant approved early childhood qualification.

* Experience in a leadership, centre manager, or educational leadership role preferred.

* Working With Children Check or relevant clearance.

* Knowledge of early childhood regulations, compliance, and quality standards.

* Current first aid, asthma, and anaphylaxis certificates preferred.



KPI Bonus



This role includes the opportunity to earn a KPI-based bonus. Bonus eligibility may be linked to centre performance, including:



* Achieving and maintaining high occupancy levels.

* Strong family satisfaction and retention.

* Positive team performance and staff engagement.

* Compliance and quality outcomes.

* Successful enrolment conversion and centre growth.

* Friendly and family-focused workplace culture.

* Opportunity to travel to Perth as part of the role.

title: Senior Accountant & Financial Advisor for Ecommerce Business
description:
About Us



Encore Pacific Brands is a growing e-commerce company that acquires and operates consumer

brands on Amazon, TikTok Shop and Shopify. We are a small, nimble team that values

ownership, resourcefulness, and clear communication. We’re looking for someone who can take

full ownership of our bookkeeping and accounting function and grow with us as we scale.



Role Overview



We’re hiring a detail-oriented Senior Accountant & Financial Advisor to manage our day-to-day

financial operations across multiple brands and sales channels. You’ll be the person who keeps

our books clean, our COGS accurate, and our financial picture clear. This role touches

everything from transaction reconciliation and bank account management to supplier payment

coordination and cost analysis.



Key Responsibilities



Bookkeeping & Reconciliation

• Manage and maintain our books in QuickBooks Online, including chart of accounts,

journal entries, bank reconciliations, and monthly close processes.

• Pull and reconcile transaction data from multiple sources: Amazon Seller Central, TikTok

Shop, Shopify, and any future sales channels.

• Download, categorize, and reconcile credit card statements from Chase, Capital One,

and American Express.

• Ensure all transactions are accurately coded and recorded on a timely basis.

COGS Management & Updates

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) across all products

whenever new inventory batches arrive.

• Update COGS figures across our internal SKU master spreadsheet, QuickBooks, and all

other reporting systems and tools so that margins and profitability data remain consistent

everywhere.

• Flag significant COGS changes and communicate the impact on gross margins to

leadership.



Supplier Payments & Wire Transfers

• Review, track, and file all invoices, payments, and shipping documents. (We work with

25+ suppliers, 1,000+ SKUs, and 50+ shipments per year.)

• Plan, prepare, and set up outgoing wire transfers to suppliers in our Chase business

account for the CEO to review and approve.

• Maintain a payment calendar and ensure suppliers are paid on time per agreed terms.

• Keep organized records of all supplier invoices, payment confirmations, and banking

documentation.



Reporting & Analysis

• Generate regular financial reports, including P&L statements, balance sheets, and cash

flow summaries for each brand.

• Support ad-hoc financial analyses as needed, such as profitability by product line,

channel-level performance, or cost-saving opportunities.

• Assist with preparing financial data for tax filings and work with our external CPA as

needed.



Typical Questions You Will Find the Answer To

• What is the current profitability of each brand in our portfolio?

• What is our profitability at a SKU level? Which products are dragging down margins?

• How much did we spend on shipping and freight in the last quarter, and how does that

compare to the prior period?

• What are our landed COGS for this new batch, and how does it change our margin on

these SKUs?

• How much cash do we need to set aside for upcoming supplier wires over the next

30/60/90 days?

• What is the inventory value across Amazon FBA, third-party warehouses, and in-transit

shipments?

• What does leadership need from this financial data to make a sound decision, and how

can I present it in the clearest way possible?



Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online – this is our primary accounting platform and

you should be very comfortable navigating it.

• Experience pulling and reconciling data from e-commerce platforms (Amazon Seller

Central, Shopify, TikTok Shop, or similar).

• Experience reconciling credit card and bank statements from U.S. financial institutions.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple brands/entities

simultaneously.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Reliable internet connection and a professional remote work setup.



Strongly Preferred

• Master’s degree in Accounting or a CPA/CMA designation.

• Prior experience as a bookkeeper or accountant for Amazon FBA or e-commerce

businesses.

• Familiarity with COGS tracking, landed cost calculations, and inventory accounting.

• Experience setting up or preparing international wire transfers through U.S. bank portals

(Chase, etc.).

• Comfort working with spreadsheets (Google Sheets / Excel) for SKU-level data

management and analysis.

title: Amazon Launch & SEO Specialist
description:
About the Role



We're a multi-brand e-commerce business scaling consumer products on Amazon. We're looking for a senior Amazon Launch & SEO Specialist to own the keyword strategy and listing copy behind every product launch and organic ranking push across our portfolio — and to help us d
 which niches and products we pursue in the first place.



This is a hybrid role: part SEO strategist, part launch strategist, part copy owner, part market researcher. You'll research niches, understand the product and the customer buying it, identify the exact keywords we should target, and turn that into listings that rank and convert. You'll build the ranking roadmap that takes a product from launch to page-one dominance.



Crucially, we're not looking for someone who just pulls keyword lists. The best specialists today understand the product and the consumer — what problem it solves, why someone buys it, what objections they have — and use that insight to guide both keyword targeting and copy. AI research tools make this deeper level of customer understanding more accessible than ever, and we expect you to use them well.



--------

What You'll Do



- Research niches, competitors, and customers to identify high-opportunity keywords and understand the buyer behind each product

- Evaluate categories and niches before we commit to designing, manufacturing, and launching. We look into a wide range of markets each year — you'll do the upfront research to assess demand, competition, saturation, and whether a niche is worth entering at all

- Conduct market research to evaluate specific new product ideas and support new product development (NPD). We launch a large number of products every year and vet many more — you'll assess market size, competition, demand, and keyword opportunity to help us d
 which products are worth building

- Build the keyword targeting strategy for each launch — starting on torso and tail terms, then sequencing the push toward torso and head terms over the following months as products gain traction

- Own listing copy — titles, bullets, and descriptions. We have in-house Claude-based tools to accelerate drafting, but you're responsible for the quality, keyword integration, and consumer resonance of every listing before it goes to final owner approval

- Partner closely with our PPC specialist to align organic keyword strategy with paid campaigns, so ranking pushes are supported by the right ad spend

- Prioritize niche, keyword, listing, and product opportunities across a multi-brand portfolio and translate research into clear, actionable plans



-----

What We're Looking For



- Senior-level experience in Amazon organic ranking and SEO — you've personally taken products from launch to strong organic rank

- Experience evaluating niches, categories, and product viability — you can look at a market and assess whether it's worth entering

- Strong copywriting instincts — you can turn keyword research and consumer insight into listings that both rank and convert

- Genuine curiosity about products and the people who buy them; you think like a customer, not just a keyword researcher

- Deep fluency with keyword research and tracking tools: DataDive, Helium 10, or equivalent

- Strong familiarity with AI tools and a genuine eagerness to use them — you're the kind of person who reaches for AI to research faster, dig deeper into customers, and sharpen copy, while owning the final quality

- Strong grasp of Amazon's ranking mechanics and how keyword relevance, indexing, and launch velocity interact

- Ability to build a keyword strategy that evolves over a product's lifecycle, not just a one-time launch list

- Self-directed and reliable in a fully remote environment



--------

Nice to Have



Experience across multiple product categories and brands

Familiarity with the interplay between organic and paid on Amazon

Company: PCB Beachlife (Panama City Beach, FL short-term rental portfolio) 

Job Type: Full Time 40+ hours per week  

Pay: $400–$450/month (DOE, negotiable) 

Schedule: US Eastern/Central / Pacific Time for guest check-in/out and local team coordination 

Weekend coverage required (this is when most check-ins/outs happen)

About the Role

We manage a growing portfolio of premium, self-managed vacation rental properties across the US including cities like Palm Springs region, Gulf Coast of Alabama, and White Sand Beaches of Panama City Beach, Florida.  Our vacation properties are listed on Airbnb, Vrbo, Houfy and our own direct booking site. We're looking for a detail-oriented, guest-focused Virtual Assistant to be the front line of our guest experience and day-to-day operations — so our guests get fast, warm responses and our local vendor team stays coordinated, without any issues for our vacation guests.

This is a role for someone loves to be in the hospitality business, is guest and customer obsessed, and takes full ownership.  Our VA team takes pride in ensuring each guest stay is full of surprise and delight moments and the best experience to ensure guests enjoy every moment of their stay. 

Five-Star Stays Start Here

PCB Beachlife is an elevated vacation-rental brand designed for discerning, premium guests—our “Wealthy Wendy” guest profile—who expect more than a place to stay. They expect a polished, thoughtful, and effortless vacation experience from the moment they book through the moment they check out.

The Virtual Assistant in this role must be genuinely guest-obsessed and take pride in helping deliver the best vacation possible for every guest. This means thinking ahead, anticipating needs before guests have to ask, identifying potential issues early, communicating with warmth and clarity, and coordinating proactively with vendors to protect the quality of the stay. Our standard is a five-star experience at every touchpoint, delivered with ownership, care, and a hospitality-first mindset.

• Anticipate guest needs before arrival so every stay feels seamless, personal, and thoughtfully prepared.

• Communicate with warmth, professionalism, urgency, and clear ownership in every guest-facing interaction.

• Coordinate closely with cleaners, maintenance vendors, and local service providers to prevent issues and resolve concerns quickly.

• Protect the premium PCB Beachlife brand by making each guest feel cared for, respected, and confident that their vacation is in excellent hands.

Daily Responsibilities

Guest Communication

• Respond promptly and warmly to guest messages, questions, and issues across Airbnb, Vrbo, Houfy, and direct bookings

• Troubleshoot guest issues by contacting our local vendor team as needed (cleaners, pool tech, HVAC, handyman)

• Place orders to replace missing items (e.g., games, pool equipment)

• Offer upsells when a stay can be extended (adjacent open nights at a discount) or when early check-in / late check-out is available

• Confirm pool heat/spa requests with guests and coordinate activation on technology remote apps 

Pre-Arrival Checks

• Review property cameras to confirm the pools are sparkling clean and water is blue

• Confirm with cleaners that the property has been cleaned and is guest-ready

• Confirm any scheduled maintenance is completed and the property is presentable

• Check smart thermostats are set correctly for the season (70–75°F Apr–Oct, 68–73°F Nov–Mar)

• Confirm WiFi is online, smart locks are connected, and access codes are generated and sent to guests along with house info (WiFi, lock code, Instagram, digital guest book)

Guest Experience Touches

• Send a check-out day thank-you message to every guest, inviting them back

• For 5-star guests, arrange a small thank-you gesture (e.g., breakfast delivery) on check-out morning

Weekly Responsibilities

Social Media & Marketing

• Post property availability/openings in relevant
 groups (local buy/sell/trade groups, traveler groups, STR host communities)

• Monitor comments and engagement in these groups and respond as our voice

• Maintain and post to Instagram accounts for each property

• Draft a monthly "Top 5 things to do in the area" newsletter for our guest list

Bookkeeping Support

• Categorize business expenses in our expense tracking system

Recurring Maintenance Tracking (you'll own the calendar/reminders, not the physical work)

• Track and schedule quarterly or annual tasks: smoke detector battery changes, smart lock battery checks, HVAC filter changes, deep cleans, fire extinguisher tag/date checks 

• Track and confirm monthly light-duty items with cleaners: window sills, slider tracks, vent/ceiling fan wipe-down, baseboards, appliance interiors (oven, fridge)

Required Experience

• Minimum of 5 years of experience working in the vacation rental industry as a Virtual Assistant, preferably supporting short-term rental hosts, co-hosts, or property management companies.

• Hands-on experience supporting guest communication, reservation coordination, owner/operator support, vendor follow-up, and day-to-day vacation rental operations.

• Experience with social media content creation, including drafting captions, creating simple graphics or reels, posting property updates, and engaging with followers or travel communities.

• Experience supporting paid ads, basic campaign setup or monitoring, promotional posts, and marketing campaigns that drive bookings or direct inquiries.

• Experience helping create, update, or manage vacation rental websites or direct booking sites is a strong plus. 

• Familiarity with Airbnb/Vrbo host tools, or PMS platforms like Hospitable, Guesty, or similar



Nice-to-Have (Not Required, But a Plus)

• Experience with AI guest-messaging tools

• Basic graphic design skills using Canva or similar tools for social posts, property promotions, and guest-facing content

What We're Looking For

• Excellent written English — guest-facing communication needs to be warm, clear, and typo-free

• Highly reliable with a strong internet connection; this role directly affects guest experience in real time

• Comfortable following detailed SOPs and checklists without needing constant oversight

• Proactive communicator — flags issues before they become guest complaints, rather than waiting for instructions

• Organized enough to manage recurring maintenance schedules across multiple properties without things falling through the cracks

Tools You'll Use

Airbnb & Vrbo host apps, a property management platform (Hospitable), AI guest-messaging assistant (HostBuddy), Google Sheets/dashboards, Meta Business Suite, Instagram, and an expense-tracking tool, remote smart home apps like Schlage, Google Nest etc.

How to Apply

Please include:

1. Your resume

2. A short note on any prior STR, hospitality, or guest-service VA experience

3. Your available hours (Philippine time and US Eastern time equivalent)

4. Your English writing sample — reply to this message in your own words describing how you'd respond to a guest complaining their AC isn't cooling on a 95° day

We are a fast-paced, client-focused business managing multiple projects simultaneously, and we are looking for a highly organised and proactive Admin / Project Coordinator to support our operations remotely.

What We Offer

Direct working relationship with the Managing Director

Opportunity to grow your skills across project management, estimating, and operations

Supportive team environment with clear processes and systems

title: Finance Analyst/ Account Analyst
description:
Atrium Housing is a mission-driven real estate development firm focused on creating affordable housing and vibrant communities. Our projects span mixed-finance and LIHTC transactions, and we pride ourselves on delivering high-quality, impactful housing solutions while fostering a collaborative, supportive, and growth-oriented work environment.



At Atrium, you’ll have the opportunity to learn directly from experienced development professionals, work on meaningful projects that impact communities, and build a strong foundation for a career in real estate finance and affordable housing development.



Role Purpose



As a Development Analyst, you’ll support affordable housing transactions through financial underwriting, due diligence coordination, and application support. While LIHTC experience is a plus, it is not required—what matters most is your analytical mindset, attention to detail, and eagerness to learn.



Primary Value You’ll Bring:



* Accurate underwriting and financial modeling

* Organized and reliable diligence tracking

* High-quality application support for housing agencies, investors, and lenders



What You’ll Do



* Build and maintain detailed financial models and sources-and-uses statements (LIHTC exposure is a bonus)

* Prepare rent schedules, operating pro formas, and subsidy layering analyses

* Support preparation of state housing agency applications

* Coordinate third-party reports such as market studies, appraisals, environmental studies, and surveys

* Maintain due diligence and closing checklists

* Assist with investor, lender, and internal memos



What We’re Looking For



Technical Competencies:



* Intermediate to advanced Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, modeling)

* LIHTC fundamentals (ideal, not required)

* Strong data organization



Behavioral Competencies:



* High attention to detail

* Responsiveness and proactive communication

* Strong accountability and ownership



Qualifications:



* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Real Estate, Economics, Planning, or related field

* 0–3 years of relevant experience

* Strong analytical and organizational skills

* Performance Metrics

* Accuracy and reliability of underwriting

* Timeliness of deliverables

* Quality and completeness of application materials

* Responsiveness to team and project needs



Why You’ll Love Working at Atrium Housing



* Impactful work: Contribute to projects that provide affordable housing and improve communities.

* Professional growth: Learn from experienced development professionals and gain exposure to mixed-finance and LIHTC projects.

* Collaborative culture: Work with a supportive, mission-driven team where your contributions matter.

* Flexible remote work: Balance your professional growth with personal life while collaborating across time zones.

title: Amazon Account Specialist
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a sharp, autonomous Amazon Account Specialist to take full ownership of our Seller Central operations. This isn't a role for someone who just follows a script; we need a problem-solver who understands the "why" behind Amazon’s rules and knows how to navigate them effectively. You will be the sole point of contact for customer inquiries, account health, and tactical compliance.



Key Responsibilities

Account Health & "Tactical" Compliance: Monitor account health dashboard daily. Handle restricted product flags, documentation requests, and compliance hurdles. You should be comfortable finding creative, effective ways to resolve "non-traditional" compliance issues and navigating Amazon’s automated systems to keep listings active.



Customer Experience: Manage the daily inbox (typically 1–2 messages per day). Provide high-quality, professional responses that protect our seller rating and resolve buyer issues instantly. 



Seller Central Troubleshooting: Act as the primary liaison with Seller Support. Fight for case resolutions, fix stranded inventory, and update listing data as needed. BRAND ANALYTICS is a REQUIREMENT is needed for this role.



Operational Support: General administrative tasks related to the Amazon storefront to ensure "everything is just handled."



The Ideal Candidate

The "Amazon Veteran": You’ve been inside Seller Central long enough to know that "The Rules" and "How things actually work" are often two different things.



Smart & Adaptive: Since volume is low, we don't need a robot. We need someone who can spend their time researching new workarounds or optimizing a process when things are quiet.



High Level of Discretion: You understand the nuances of compliance in the Amazon world and can execute strategies to keep the account safe without overcomplicating simple tasks.



English Fluency: Excellent written English is a must for both customer service and drafting persuasive appeals to Amazon.



Technical Requirements

Proven experience with Amazon Seller Central (specifically Account Health and Case Logs).



Experience handling "difficult" compliance or reinstatement issues is a major plus.



Ability to work independently with minimal daily supervision.

title: Amazon Product Sourcing & Research | China Negotiation | 3+ Years PL Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands - one in the travel accessories category and one in beauty devices - with 52+ active SKUs.



We're not a startup figuring things out - we have systems, a team, and a clear direction. What we need now is someone senior who can take full ownership of product development for one of our brands while we scale.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is a specialist position for someone who has done this before and can work independently.

You will own the full product lifecycle for one brand: from identifying opportunities, to negotiating with Chinese suppliers on WeChat, to making sure samples, timelines, packaging, and user manuals are all on track before launch. You'll also do product research for our second brand.

You'll work closely with our marketing and design team, and report directly to the owner.



What You'll Do Daily:

- Conduct product research across Amazon marketplaces (US/CA/UK/EU/AU/JP)

- Analyze competition, demand, pricing, and profitability (ROI, FBA fees, net margin)

- Communicate directly with Chinese suppliers via WeChat - negotiate pricing, MOQs, timelines

- Request and evaluate samples, coordinate quality checks

- Monitor production timelines and flag delays before they become problems

- Review packaging and user manuals for compliance (not copy, just accuracy)

- Calculate profitability at every stage before committing to a launch

- Collaborate with marketing and graphic design teams on launch prep

- Report weekly with recommendations and progress updates



Tools You Must Know:

- Helium 10 (Cerebro, Black Box, Xray, Keyword Tracker)

- Keepa - price history, trends, seasonality

- Amazon Seller Central - BSR, sales data interpretation

- Alibaba + WeChat - supplier sourcing and negotiation

- Google Sheets / Excel - ROI models, dashboards, profitability trackers

- Jungle Scout - a plus



Who We're Looking For:

- 3–5 years experience in Amazon Private Label product development and sourcing

- You've negotiated directly with Chinese suppliers - not just browsed Alibaba

- You think in numbers: margins, costs, lead times, risks

- You communicate clearly in English, written and verbal

- You're organized and proactive - you chase timelines, you don't wait to be chased

- You want a long-term role with room to grow, not a short contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,000–$1,400/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor (removed after we establish trust)

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



Important

This role is for one of our brands that currently has no team. You'll be building from the ground up with clear direction from ownership. If you need someone to micromanage your daily tasks, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and autonomy, keep reading.





To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a product you sourced from a Chinese supplier, how did you find them, how did you negotiate, and what was the final outcome? Include the platform you used to find them (Alibaba, WeChat, trade show etc.), the MOQ you negotiated, and one specific thing that almost went wrong. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

2. Walk me through your evaluation process for a Private Label product - what metrics matter most to you, what makes you say no, and what makes you say yes? Give a real example without naming the product. What's your process, not your tools.

3. What tools do you use daily for Amazon product research, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - walk me through one specific thing you do in it that most people skip or don't know about.

4. What's the biggest mistake you've seen (or made) in product development, and what did you change after? Be specific.

Help Run the Back End of a Growing Healthcare Practice

Your primary responsibility is not creating content or designing marketing campaigns. Your role is to keep the back end of the practice running smoothly so I can focus on patient care and growing the business.

* Respond to patient
s and messages

mbers

title: Right-Hand Partner & Virtual Assistant to a Real Estate Media Founder (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
I'm hiring a full-time assistant to take work off my plate and grow into a real right-hand person over time. This is more than a task list, and I'll put a lot of my own time into training you.



I want someone early in their career who is smart, coachable, and genuinely wants to get good at this. Attitude and how fast you learn matter more to me than a long resume, though you'll need some real experience as an executive assistant already, plus hands-on comfort using AI (more on both below).



The biggest thing you'll get out of this role is real AI skill.



I use AI to run most of what I do, and I build my own AI tools. If you join, I'll show you how I actually do it: the prompts, the workflows, the systems I use for content, research, and reporting. Not the surface-level stuff you can find on YouTube, but the real setup I work in every day.



Most VAs put "ChatGPT" on their resume and stop there. I want to take you well past that. Stick with it and you'll understand how to use AI inside a real business better than almost anyone around you, and that stays with you wherever your career goes.



Here's what I'll teach you:

- AI. How I run an AI-first business day to day, and how to build with these tools instead of just typing questions into them. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, ElevenLabs, and whatever's best next.

- Strategy. You'll sit close to how decisions actually get made, and take on more of them as you earn it.

- Business. I'll give you the reason behind what we're doing, not just the task.



===



THE ROLE

I run a growing real estate investing media & content brand (newsletter, podcast, and social publishing), and I'm building a second venture alongside it. I need a world-class right-hand person to be the operational backbone of the media side — so it keeps growing while I focus on the new business.



This is not a typical VA role. You'll own the day-to-day, keep our content engine running, and free up my time. That takes a real partnership, proactive problem-solving, and total ownership.



- Hours: Full-time — 8 hours a day, 5 days a week (40 hrs/week). At least 4 of your 8 daily hours must overlap with US business hours [specify your window, e.g. 9 AM–1 PM ET] so we can work together in real time. The other ~4 hours are flexible; work them whenever suits you.

- Compensation: $500/month to start, with raises as you grow into more responsibility.

- Commitment: This is a long-term role, and I'm committed for the long term too. I'll put real time into training you, so I'm looking for someone who wants to grow with the business over the years, not a short gig.

- Provided: Full AI and tool access, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and everything else you'll need to do the job.





===





WHAT YOU'LL DO (YOUR MISSION)

Bring order, structure, and 
ntum to the business. You'll turn my ideas into executed projects and my priorities into daily routines.



- Content operations: Run our publishing across newsletter and social platforms (Substack, LinkedIn,
, X, Instagram) — posting, community engagement, and keeping the pipeline a week ahead.

 - Podcast production: Edit and publish episodes on schedule (DaVinci Resolve, ElevenLabs — I'll train you). When I say two episodes this week, two episodes ship.

- Metrics & reporting: Track engagement and follower growth, and send me a clear week-over-week report — signal, not noise.

- Research & admin: Run research projects and hand back decision-ready summaries; help manage my calendar and the admin that keeps things moving.

- Process improvement: Learn our existing playbook first, then help make it smarter — spotting bottlenecks and proposing better ways.



===





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR (IS THIS YOU?)

Here's what you must bring. These are non-negotiable:



- You already use AI in your daily work. You have your own tools and a setup you can walk me through (the application asks about this). You don't need to be an expert, but you can't be starting from zero. I'll take you a lot further than where you are now.

- You communicate clearly. You can explain what you're doing and where things stand in a way that's easy to follow. You're direct and honest, even when the update isn't all good news.

- You're goal-driven, not task-driven. You focus effort where it moves the goal. If something is eating hours without paying off, you flag it and ask — you don't quietly disappear into low-value work.

- You act on feedback. You take it as a gift, change your behavior the first time, and I never have to give the same note twice.

- You over-communicate and follow through. Silence is your enemy. When something slips, you say so early with a plan. When you commit to a deliverable, it ships. "Getting things done" is your identity.

- Deep growth mindset. Curious, coachable, and hungry to learn the business — you develop enough of a point of view to push back with reasons, not just take orders.

- Prior Executive Assistant experience. You've supported a founder or executive before and know how to manage someone's time, tasks, and priorities.



===





NICE TO HAVE (not required — I'll teach the rest)

- Managing social media for brands — a big plus. If you've grown or run social accounts for a business, tell me about it.

- Interest in real estate, investing, or finance content

- Podcast or video editing (DaVinci Resolve, ElevenLabs)



===





HOW TO APPLY

Everything is in the application form, and I read every submission personally. The form takes real effort on purpose — I'd rather have 10 thoughtful applications than 200 rushed ones. You'll be asked for:



A few short questions about how you work — including how you handle feedback and how you spend your time

Your portfolio and the tools you use to stay organized

A short Google Doc (300 words) on your favorite AI project/setup and how it helps your day-to-day

A 2-minute video on why you're the best fit

Read every question carefully and follow each instruction exactly. This role lives or dies on attention to detail, clear communication, and follow-through, and I can tell within the first two answers who read the post and who skimmed it.

title: Amazon Operations and Team Manager| 3+ Years Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands: one in travel accessories and one in beauty devices, with 52+ active SKUs. We're at a turning point: moving from a founder-run business to a properly managed, systems-run company. This role is central to that transition.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is an operations and team management position for someone who has done this before in an ecommerce or Amazon environment.



You will report directly to the two Founders and manage a team of 8-9 people across our Creative and Operations teams. You'll take our existing processes - currently scattered and undocumented - and build a proper system in ClickUp from scratch. You'll create SOPs, track KPIs, run tea
etings, and make sure everyone knows what they're doing and when.



Your mission is to build the systems, rhythm, and accountability that let the company run smoothly, without the founders being involved in every daily decision.



If you need someone to tell you what to do every day, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and the autonomy to build real systems - and you're just as comfortable doing the daily operational grind as you are building the systems - keep reading.



What You'll Do:

-Set up ClickUp from scratch across all departments: workflows, dashboards, automations, task structures

-Make sure all work is captured in the system - nothing managed informally or lost in chat

-Be the team's first point of contact for day-to-day questions and blockers - not the founders

-Chase deadlines directly with tea
mbers and follow up when tasks haven't been updated

-Coordinate between Creative and Operations teams so projects move smoothly, resolving small cross-department friction points without escalating

-Document existing business processes into clear, usable SOPs

-Handle day-to-day approvals within defined boundaries, escalating only real issues to the founders

-Lead weekly/monthly KPI reviews and quarterly planning sessions

-Run the weekly tea
eting - status updates, blockers, decisions - focused and on time

-Translate founders' quarterly objectives into clear team and individual goals

-Monitor performance, spot problems early, and drive corrective action

-Track and report operational KPIs and cost trends, flagging profitability signals for the founders' review

-Build and manage the product-launch workflow based on the existing 15-step launch process

-Spot what's slowing the team down and fix it - don't just flag it

-Onboard new hires: set up tools, assign SOPs, guide their first weeks



Where the Founders Stay Involved

To be clear about where this role starts and stops: the Founders will continue to own overall company direction and priorities; brand, product, and market strategy; final decisions on launches, positioning, and pricing; approval of budgets, salaries, hiring/firing, and major investments; and review of high-level KPIs and reports.



This role owns everything else: the daily execution, systems, and team accountability that make those strategic decisions possible - including the follow-up, reminders, and day-to-day problem-solving that used to fall on the founders.



Tools You Must Know:

-ClickUp - expert level, you've built systems from scratch before

-Google Sheets / Excel - KPI dashboards, reporting

-Slack or similar - team communication

-Amazon Seller Central - you don't need to be a specialist, but you need to understand the context

-Zoom - weekly meetings with owner and team



Who We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who's been in the trenches of ecommerce operations - not someone who's managed tasks, but someone who's built systems and led people.



-3+ years in operations or team management in an ecommerce or Amazon environment

-You've built SOPs from scratch and know how to make processes that people actually follow

-You've set up ClickUp or similar tools for a team starting from zero

-You know how to keep a remote team aligned and accountable - without being on their back every hour

-You're comfortable with numbers - KPIs, margins, performance tracking

-You're energized by the operational grind, not just the systems and dashboards, because that's most of what this role actually is day to day

-Excellent English, written and verbal

-Familiarity with Amazon tools

-You're looking for somewhere to grow long-term, not just another contract



Compensation & Setup:

-$1,800-$2,000/month based on experience

-Full-time, 40h/week

-14 days paid leave after 3 months

-First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor as part of our standard onboarding process

-Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



What Success Looks Like

-Within 1 month: ClickUp is fully adopted, the weekly rhythm is running, and the founders' approval load has dropped significantly

-Within 3 months: KPIs are tracked and reviewed consistently; the team works to clear quarterly goals

-Within 6 months: the company runs smoothly day-to-day without the founders being involved in every decision



To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. 



1. Describe a project management system you built from scratch (ClickUp, Asana, Monday, or similar) - what was the situation, how did you structure it, and what changed after? Only apply if you have actually done this. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you did.

2. How do you hold a remote team accountable without micromanaging? Give a real example from one of the companies listed in your CV: include the team size, what tool you used, and what happened when someone missed a deadline. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

3. Walk me through a company from your CV where you managed people — how many reported directly to you, what were their roles, and what did your  one-on-ones or check-ins with them actually look like? What's one decision about a tea
mber (raise, warning, letting someone go, promotion) that was yours to make?

4. What project management tools have you used, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - what's one thing you can do in it that most people don't know about?





Please also include your salary expectation and availability.

title: Healthcare Practice Operations Specialist
description:
Build Systems. Create Order. Help a Growing Practice Thrive.



I'm the owner of a growing chiropractic and wellness practice, and I'm looking for someone who enjoys creating structure, keeping projects moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

A successful Practice Operations Specialist helps create a business where:



Patients are consistently followed up with.

Appointments stay organized and scheduled.

Projects move forward without constant reminders.

Workshops and events are prepared ahead of time.

Information is organized and easy to find.

The business owner can focus on patient care because the back office is running smoothly.

Schedule and reschedule appointments

Follow up with patients who need to return for care

Assist patients with intake forms and payment updates

Coordinate with our billing team as needed

Ensure every patient interaction is professional, warm, and timely

Follow up with warm leads

Research local businesses and community partners

Help coordinate workshops and community events

Maintain organized outreach lists

Content Support

Create graphics in Canva

Format and schedule social media posts

Assist with simple reels and video editing

Use AI tools to adapt content while maintaining our brand voice

Skills & Experience

Google Workspace

Canva

Slack

Electronic Health Record (EHR) software (experience with Jane App is a plus)

CRM systems such as GoHighLevel (helpful but not required)



Most importantly, you enjoy learning new systems and becoming highly proficient with them.



What I'm Looking For



The right person is someone who:



Follows through on commitments.

Pays attention to details.

Communicates proactively.

Asks thoughtful questions instead of making assumptions.

Enjoys solving organizational problems.

Is dependable and consistent.

Takes pride in doing excellent work.

Is excited by continuous learning and professional growth.



You don't need to know everything on day one.



I care much more about your willingness to learn, communicate, and improve than I do about knowing every piece of software we use.



Growth



This role is intended to grow with the practice.



As trust develops, you'll take ownership of more projects, systems, and responsibilities. My long-term vision is to have someone who oversees the daily operations of the practice so I can spend more time serving patients and growing the business.



If you're looking for a position where you can make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and become an integral part of a business over time, I'd love to hear from you.

Your resume

title: Amazon Listing Growth Specialist (DataDive Expert Required)
description:
If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job.  You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description.  



Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.  

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.  









We are looking for a senior Amazon listing operator who knows how to launch, rank, and scale products on Amazon — not just write copy. You live inside DataDive, Helium 10, and Brand Analytics, and you can read a niche the way most people read a book.



You will own the full lifecycle of our Amazon listings: from keyword research and competitive analysis on day one, through launch, ranking, and ongoing optimization. You will be responsible for the data-driven decisions that move our products up the page.



You are the person who answers every week:

• “Which keywords are we winning, losing, or missing?”

• “Why did this listing drop in rank?”

• “What is the next listing we should optimize, and why?”

• “Where is the next growth opportunity in this category?”



What You Will Own

Keyword Research & Competitive Analysis

• Run deep keyword research in DataDive (Cerebro-style reverse ASIN, competitor gap analysis, keyword opportunity scoring)

• Build keyword master lists segmented by priority, search volume, relevance, and competition

• Identify untapped long-tail and high-intent keywords competitors are missing

• Analyze competitor listings, reviews, pricing, and ranking patterns

• Map the competitive landscape for every product line

New Listing Launch

• Build SEO-optimized titles, bullets, descriptions, and backend search terms

• Write A+ Content briefs and Brand Story modules

• Coordinate image and infographic briefs with the design team

• Develop launch strategy: pricing, coupons, vine, PPC seeding, and ranking plan

• Set up parent/child variations correctly the first time

• Track launch performance against ranking and revenue targets



Ongoing Listing Optimization

• Audit existing listings for keyword gaps, indexing issues, and conversion leaks

• Run structured A/B tests on titles, main images, and copy using Manage Your Experiments

• Monitor keyword rank movements and respond to ranking drops fast

• Refresh listings based on seasonality, trends, and new competitor moves

• Improve conversion rate, session-to-purchase ratio, and click-through rate



Brand Analytics & Seller Central Intelligence

• Pull and interpret Search Query Performance, Top Search Terms, and Market Basket reports

• Identify share-of-voice gaps vs. top competitors in each category

• Track conversion share, click share, and purchase share by keyword

• Use Seller Central data to validate or challenge DataDive findings

• Flag listing health issues: suppressions, Buy Box loss, policy warnings, stranded inventory



Reporting & Dashboards



You will build and maintain:

• Weekly keyword rank tracker (organic and sponsored)

• Listing health scorecard by ASIN

• Competitor watchlist with movement alerts

• Launch performance reports vs. plan

• Optimization backlog with projected impact and priority



Who You Are



You are not a generalist Amazon VA. You are:

• A senior Amazon operator who has launched and scaled real products — not just edited listings

• A true DataDive power user (this is non-negotiable)

• Deeply analytical — you make decisions from data, not from gut feel

• Obsessive about keyword indexing, ranking, and conversion

• Comfortable reading Search Query Performance reports and explaining what they mean

• Up to date on Amazon algorithm changes, policy updates, and category trends

• A strong written communicator who can brief designers, copywriters, and leadership clearly

• Self-directed — you bring opportunities to the table, you don’t wait to be told



Required Experience

• 5+ years managing Amazon listings at a senior or lead level

• Proven track record of launching products and ranking them on page 1 for competitive keywords

• Expert-level proficiency in DataDive (required — we will test this)

• Strong working knowledge of Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet, Frankenstein, Index Checker)

• Hands-on experience with Brand Analytics and Seller Central reporting

• Experience writing high-converting Amazon copy and A+ Content briefs

• Experience running Manage Your Experiments (A/B tests) on titles and images

• Strong spreadsheet skills (pivots, lookups, basic modeling)

• Familiarity with Amazon Ads / PPC concepts (you don’t need to run campaigns, but you need to understand them)



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full keyword and competitor audit completed for every active ASIN

• Prioritized optimization backlog built and in motion

• At least one major listing relaunch with measurable rank and conversion lift

• Weekly reporting cadence established with leadership

• Clear launch playbook documented for future product releases



Why This Role Matters

Amazon is a zero-sum game. For every rank position we don’t own, a competitor does. The right person in this seat directly drives revenue — every keyword you win, every conversion point you add, and every launch you nail compounds over months and years.



How to Apply



Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• A specific example of a listing you launched or optimized, with the keyword(s) you targeted and the rank/revenue result

• How long you have used DataDive and what you use it for most

• One Amazon listing mistake you see most operators make — and how you avoid it

title: Marketplace Multichannel specialist
description:
If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job. You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description.



Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.



About the Role

We are looking for a multi-channel listing specialist who can build, launch, and optimize product listings across five very different marketplaces: Shopify, Walmart, Target, eBay, and Wayfair.

This is a listings-focused role. You will not be running ads or managing inventory sync — your job is to make sure every product we sell shows up clean, accurate, optimized, and conversion-ready on every channel where it lives.

You understand that each marketplace plays by its own rules. Shopify gives you total creative control. Walmart and Target demand strict content compliance and category-specific attribute precision. eBay rewards keyword density and item specifics. Wayfair is its own world of merchandising, dimensions, and class-level requirements. You know how to switch contexts and execute correctly on all five.

You are the person who asks every week:

• “Which listings are underperforming, and on which channel?”

• “Where are we missing keywords, attributes, or images?”

• “Which listings are flagged, suppressed, or non-compliant?”

• “Where is the biggest optimization opportunity this week?”

What You Will Own

Shopify

• Build product pages with SEO-optimized titles, descriptions, and meta data

• Manage collections, tags, and product organization

• Configure variants, options, and inventory display

• Optimize images, alt text, and structured data for search

• Coordinate with design team on PDP layout, badges, and on-page assets

Walmart Marketplace

• Create and maintain item setups via Item Spec or bulk upload

• Optimize titles, key features, descriptions, and rich media

• Ensure full attribute completeness (Walmart’s Listing Quality Score)

• Manage category-specific compliance and content scorecards

• Resolve content errors, item processing failures, and unpublished items

Target Plus

• Build item setup files following Target’s strict content guidelines

• Write titles and copy that match Target’s brand voice and guest tone

• Manage attribute completeness, images, and enhanced content

• Work within Target Plus Partners portal to maintain item status

• Coordinate item approval and resubmission workflows

eBay

• Build listings with optimized titles (80-character usage) and complete item specifics

• Write keyword-rich descriptions structured for eBay’s search algorithm

• Use eBay’s product catalog and category-specific required fields correctly

• Manage variation listings, store categories, and promotional content

• Monitor and improve listing quality, search visibility, and Best Match positioning

Wayfair

• Build product feeds with accurate class, dimensions, materials, and merchandising attributes

• Write Wayfair-style titles, marketing copy, and bullet features that convert in their PDP layout

• Manage image requirements, lifestyle imagery, and dimension diagrams

• Resolve content rejection issues and class-level data gaps

• Maintain product data quality scores within the Wayfair Partner Home dashboard

Cross-Channel Quality & Reporting

• Maintain a master content library so titles, copy, images, and attributes stay consistent across channels

• Adapt content to each channel’s rules — never copy-paste the same listing everywhere

• Audit existing listings on every channel for gaps, errors, and optimization opportunities

• Track listing health and content scorecards on every platform

• Build a weekly status report showing active, pending, suppressed, and flagged listings by channel

Who You Are

You are not a generalist VA. You are:

• A multi-channel listing operator who has worked in at least 3 of these 5 platforms hands-on

• Fluent in the language of product data: titles, attributes, item specifics, taxonomy, GTINs, variants

• Detail-obsessed — a missing attribute or wrong category is a personal offense

• A strong writer who can shift tone between Shopify, Target, eBay, and Wayfair without thinking about it

• Comfortable working inside multiple seller portals every day

• Calm under spreadsheet pressure — you can manage hundreds of SKUs without losing track

• Self-directed — you flag issues, propose fixes, and execute without hand-holding

Required Experience

• 3+ years building and optimizing product listings on marketplaces and Shopify

• Hands-on experience in at least 3 of the following: Shopify, Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, eBay, Wayfair

• Working knowledge of marketplace content quality requirements and scorecards

• Strong copywriting skills for product titles, bullets, and descriptions

• Comfortable with bulk uploads, item setup templates, and feed files (CSV / Excel)

• Strong spreadsheet skills (formulas, lookups, pivots)

• Working knowledge of product taxonomy, GTINs, UPCs, and category attribute structures

• Experience coordinating with design teams on image requirements per channel

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full content audit completed across all 5 channels

• Master content library built and maintained as source of truth

• Prioritized optimization backlog in motion, by channel

• Listing quality scores improved on Walmart, Target, and Wayfair

• Weekly multi-channel status report established with leadership

• Clear playbook documented for launching a new product across all 5 channels

Why This Role Matters

Every channel we sell on is a storefront, and every storefront is judged on its weakest listing. The right person in this seat protects our brand, lifts conversion across the board, and turns five marketplaces into five well-run businesses instead of five neglected ones.

Work Hours

Monday through Friday, Pacific Standard Time.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• Which of the 5 channels you have the most experience on, and how long

• A specific listing you built or optimized — what you changed, and the result

• The biggest difference, in your view, between writing a Shopify product page and a Walmart listing

title: Mid-Senior PHP/Laravel Developer
description:
About KomX



Kommunale Exzellenz (KomX) is an early-stage SaaS platform that digitizes the organizational structure and internal processes of German municipal administrations. Tasks are the cornerstone rights, workflows, and responsibilities flow from organizational positions and the tasks attached to them, not from individual user identities. We are currently working with one development-partner municipality and preparing for broader rollout.



We are hiring our first engineering hire: a senior PHP/Laravel developer to work alongside founder on a feature-rich, working-but-raw codebase originally built with AI assistance.



Responsibilities



-Build and maintain the automated test suite. Take a feature-rich codebase from near-zero coverage to a real regression safety net, one critical flow at a time. This is core to the role and the standing weekly discipline.

-Harden security and GDPR compliance. Work through a prioritized audit backlog and security-review every new feature before it ships.

-Establish release engineering. Introduce self-hosted version control, CI, and a staging pipeline that ends in a verified, scripted release package.

-Own pre-production verification. Run the staging tier, reproduce reported issues locally from sanitized descriptions, and dry-run every migration against a populated test tenant before it reaches production.

-Review AI-generated code. Act as the human quality gate for code produced with AI assistance. -Honest pushback is the explicit expectation — “looks fine to me” without verification is the one output this role must never produce.

-Manage technical debt and consistency. Consolidate duplicated logic, keep documentation true, and enforce the codebase’s established patterns.



Qualifications

You have:

-3+ years professional PHP, with strong recent Laravel 11 or 12 experience

-PostgreSQL fluency — JSON operators, enums, indexes, query plans

-Experience with multi-tenant Laravel applications (stancl/tenancy v3 multi-database mode hands-on is a plus; we’ll ramp you on the specifics)

-Working knowledge of spatie/laravel-permission

-Confidence with Blade templating and vanilla JavaScript (no SPA framework, no Livewire, no Inertia)

-GDPR fundamentals — data minimization, retention, deletion rights (Art. 15/17/20)

-Git proficiency

-PHPUnit experience, including factories and multi-tenant test bootstrapping

-AI tool fluency (Claude Code, Copilot, or equivalent), with the discipline to override the AI when it’s wrong



You are:

-Fluent in English, written and spoken

-Comfortable with mostly async work plus one daily sync during overlap hours

-Energized by bringing engineering discipline to a raw codebase

-Willing to help shape engineering processes and tooling, not just write code

-Willing to tell the founder “the AI got this wrong, here’s why”



How We Work:

-Mostly async, one daily sync. You control your working rhythm. One focused daily sync during overlap hours plus a written daily update in our shared workspace.

-Overlap windows. PH 12:00–2:00 PM (Germany 6:00–8:00 AM) or PH 10:00 PM onwards (Germany 4:00 PM onwards), plus full weekends. You only need one of these per day for the sync — not your whole working day.



Engagement and Compensation:

-Full-time freelance engagement, approximately 40 hours per week, with KomX as your primary engagement. You can take on other clients as long as they don’t compete for your availability during our overlap windows or conflict with delivery commitments. Please disclose any existing engagements during the interview process.



-Compensation is negotiated based on experience and fit — share your monthly rate expectation in your application.



-30-day notice either side, at any point in the engagement.



How to Apply:

Please include:

-A brief note on why this role interests you

-Your CV or LinkedIn profile

-2–3 examples of past work

-Your monthly rate expectation

-Earliest possible start date

Send to 
 read every application personally.
