title: Inbound Sales and Scheduling Coordinator (US Pacific Hours)
description:
We are a growing junk removal company in the Pacific Northwest looking for a sharp, all-around front-of-house person. You will be the first point of contact across every way a customer reaches us: phone calls,
 leads, website form leads, and text. We need someone who can hold a conversation, handle pushback, and turn an interested lead into a booked job no matter where it came from. This is a full-time, long-term role working a set weekly schedule. You must be comfortable and consistent on this exact schedule.



Your specific schedule:

- Monday through Friday: 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM Pacific (7:00 AM to 11:00 AM Philippine time)

- Saturday and Sunday: 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pacific (11:00 PM to 9:00 AM Philippine time)



This totals 40 hours per week. Your weekday hours are a normal morning shift your time. Your weekend shifts are overnight your time. We need someone who is fully comfortable with both and dependable on this exact pattern, since on weekends you are the only coordinator covering our phones for the entire day.



What you will do:

- Answer inbound calls live and respond to texts quickly

- Work
 lead form submissions and website Google form leads fast, while they are still warm, following up by call and message

- Qualify each lead: name, phone, city, items, load size, preferred date

- Handle common objections with confidence and keep the conversation moving toward a booking. Examples you will hear daily: that is more than I expected, I need to think about it, can you do better on price, I want to call around first, why do you need to come look before quoting

- Book jobs and estimates in our scheduling software and keep the calendar organized across four service areas

- Follow our pricing sheet exactly and quote firm single-item prices only, never a range

- Keep clear, accurate notes in every customer record

- Escalate anything you cannot resolve to our operations manager with a clean handoff



What we are looking for:

- Excellent spoken and written English, clear and warm on the phone and in writing

- Proven ability to handle objections without being pushy. We want someone who listens, addresses the real concern, and asks for the booking

- Comfortable juggling multiple lead sources at once without letting any go cold

- Experience with Housecall Pro and GoHighLevel is a strong plus (tell us in your application if you have used either)

- Background in appointment setting, inbound sales, dispatch, scheduling, or lead follow-up

- Dependable on the exact weekly schedule listed above including both weekend overnight shifts, strong internet, quiet call environment, working headset

- Extremely detail-oriented and calm under pressure



This role lives or dies on attention to detail, so we have built that into how you apply. Please read every step carefully before you reply.



To apply, reply with:

1. Begin your message with the word SIGNAL in all caps as the very first word. This tells us you read the full post.

2. A short note on your experience with phone-based scheduling or sales, and any experience working leads from
 or web forms

3. Whether you have used Housecall Pro or GoHighLevel

4. Confirm you can work the exact schedule above, written out in both Pacific time and your local Philippine time for both the weekday and weekend blocks, so we know you fully understand the hours

5. A short answer to this scenario: a customer calls, sounds interested, but says they need to check with their spouse before booking. In two or three sentences, how do you respond?

6. A one to two minute voice recording introducing yourself. In the same recording, pretend a customer just said your price is higher than another company I called. Walk us through how you would respond.



A note on quality: we read every word of your application. Please proofread it. Replies with spelling or grammar mistakes, or replies that ignore any of the steps above, will not be considered, no matter how strong the rest looks. We are not trying to be harsh. The job is detail work, and your application is your first sample of it.



We value people who want to grow with us. This is a stable, long-term position with a team that treats its people well.

title: E-commerce Marketing Manager (Fractional / Part-Time)
description:
Job Title: E-commerce Marketing Manager (Part-Time / Fractional)



About Us:

Dirty Tackle is a fast-growing Australian e-commerce fishing brand. We sell high-quality, visual fishing gear and lures (including our Expedition Reef Box and Dirty Prawn lures) directly to passionate fishos across Australia. 



We have a massive library of raw customer photos and video assets, an existing external social media production team (Zharkwave), and a functional Shopify store. We are now looking for a reliable, proactive Marketing Manager to step in, take true ownership of our digital ecosystem, and help us scale into retail B2B markets.



Role Overview:

We don't want a task-taker; we want an owner. You will sit across the top of our marketing efforts. You will manage our micro-budgets on Meta ($1,200 AUD/mo) and Google ($400/mo), direct our creative partners at Zharkwave to produce high-performing ad creatives, and spearhead our organic and B2B retail outreach strategies.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Paid Ads & Shopify Optimization

* Meta & Google Ads Management: Oversee our active ad spend. Focus on high-return, simplified setups (e.g., Shopify Advantage+ campaigns, Google PMax, and standard Shopping). 

* Creative Testing Loops: Analyze performance data to see which product angles or hooks are converting, and systemise the rotation of assets to prevent ad fatigue.

* Shopify Funnel Management: Monitor the store's conversion rate and ensure basic retention funnels (like Shopify
 or Klaviyo abandoned cart flows) are optimized.



2. Creative Direction & Team Management

* Manage Zharkwave: Act as the main point of contact for our social media group. Review their deliverables, align them with our promotional calendar, and feed them specific briefs using our massive library of raw UGC (User Generated Content).

* Campaign Alignment: Ensure that paid ads, organic posts, and
 newsletters all tell the same story during product launches or holiday sales.



3. Growth & B2B Retail Outreach (Warm Lead Generation)

* Retail Scouting: Research, identify, and build a clean database of independent Australian tackle shops, regional marine stores, and potential stockists.

* B2B Pipeline Management: Manage cold and warm
 outreach to store owners using our existing wholesale catalog and brochure. Follow up on leads, share pricing sheets, and coordinate sample pack shipments.

* Organic Community Growth: Strategize ways to turn our raw customer footage into interactive community campaigns, giveaways, and database builders.



What We Are Looking For (Requirements):

* Proven E-commerce Experience: You have directly managed or overseen Shopify stores and connected Meta/Google ad accounts with a track record of driving ROAS.

* Leadership & Reliability: Excellent communication skills. You are comfortable telling an external agency what assets you need and tracking their accountability.

* Lead Generation/CRM Savvy: Experience with basic pipeline tools or Google Sheets to track B2B sales outreach.

* The "Owner" Mindset: You don't wait to be told what to do. You look at the asset library, look at the data, and pitch the strategy to the founder.

* An Interest in Fishing/Outdoor Culture: Understanding Australian larrikin/fishing culture is a massive bonus to ensure our brand voice remains authentic.



What We Offer:

* Highly competitive hourly or monthly retainer rate based on experience.

* Flexible, remote work environment.

* Clear pathway to increased hours, bonuses, and role expansion as the brand hits wholesale and revenue milestones.



Hours: 10–15 hours per week to start (Growth potential to Full-Time).

Location: Remote (Philippines Preferred).



----------------------------------------------------------------------

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

To be considered for this role, please include the answers to the following 4 questions in your application cover letter:



1. We work with an external creative team (Zharkwave) that edits our video content. If an ad campaign is underperforming due to creative fatigue, how would you structure a brief to them using our existing library of customer videos?

2. We want to get our fishing gear into local, independent Australian tackle shops. Walk me through your process for building a lead list of 50 regional tackle shops and how you would structure a 3-step warm
 sequence to introduce our wholesale catalogue.

3. What is your preferred
 marketing app for Shopify (e.g., Klaviyo, Shopify
, Mailchimp)? Give a quick example of a post-purchase automated flow you would set up to turn a one-time buyer into a repeat customer.

4. Our brand, Dirty Tackle, speaks directly to passionate Australian fishos. How would you ensure our brand's authentic, rugged, and down-to-earth voice isn't lost in your copywriting or B2B outreach?

title: F/T Executive Virtual Assistant — Multi-Business Operations
description:
Real Estate · Bookkeeping · AI-Augmented Workflow

*****

About the Role

I'm a licensed accountant and business owner in Maine. I run a boutique tax advisory firm, operate short-term rental properties, and chair a faith-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit. I'm looking for a high-trust, high-autonomy Executive VA to be my right hand across all of it.



This is not a task-runner role. I need someone who thinks two steps ahead, solves problems without escalating, and treats my businesses like their own. Eventually you'll have access to passwords, systems, vendors, and the inside of how I operate — so trust and judgment are non-negotiable.

*****

This role is not for someone who wants to be told what to do each day. Two members of my team run large parts of my operation with almost no daily direction fro
 — they take ownership, make judgment calls, and bring me solutions instead of problems. That's the standard.

If your instinct when facing a new situation is to message your boss or superior and ask "how should I handle this?" — this is not your role and you're going to waste our time and yours. If your instinct is to figure it out, take action, and then loop your superiors in with what you did and why — keep reading.



*****

What You'll Own

**Daily operations

 triage and reply on my behalf — keep my inbox tight and surface only what truly needs me

Vendor and contractor follow-up across multiple businesses (real estate, nonprofit facility, firm)

Calendar coordination, meeting prep, post meeting follow ups, and travel logistics

STR operations — communicate daily with property managers, follow up, guest communication, cleaner and handyman coordination, supplies, listing maintenance

Light bookkeeping — categorizing transactions, basic reconciliations, expense tracking, document collection

Document organization in Google Drive

Project tracking — make sure nothing falls through the cracks across the firm, the rentals, and the nonprofit



**Strategic / weekly

Daily or weekly priority briefings — what's hot, what's stuck, what needs me

Build and maintain SOPs for recurring work

Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to draft, research, summarize, and accelerate

Anticipate problems before they hit my desk





*****

Required Experience

3+ years as an Executive VA, Operations Manager, or Chief of Staff for a US-based business owner

Bookkeeping fundamentals — QuickBooks Online proficient, comfortable with P&Ls and basic reconciliations

Short-term rental experience — Airbnb and/or VRBO operations, guest communication, turnover coordination

AI fluency — you actively use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar in daily work and can talk specifically about how

Strong written English — you can communicate in my voice and tone

Can take a vague request and figure out the next three steps without asking





*****

The Person I'm Looking For

Trustworthy — full stop. Eventually you'll hold passwords to most of my world

Proactive — you find a way; you don't escalate routine decisions

Fast — same-day response is the standard, not the exception

Organized — structured, prioritized, documented is your default state

Calm under load — multiple businesses, lots of moving parts, you keep it sorted

Comfortable in a Christian-led environment — one of my organizations is a faith-based nonprofit, and faith is a real part of how I operate

Operates like an owner, not an employee — when you don't know something, you figure it out first and ask us second. My team runs on this. If it's not how you naturally work, we'll both be miserable.



*****

Tools You'll Use

Google Workspace · QuickBooks Online · OpenPhone (US VOIP for outbound calls) · Slack · Airbnb/VRBO · Claude / ChatGPT · Asana or similar PM platform





*****

Schedule & Compensation

20–30 hours/week to start, with a clear path to full-time for the right person

Core overlap with US Eastern Time required (Maine business hours)

$1,400–2,000+/month based on experience and capability, the right person has no limit as to what is possible with our growing and thriving practice, IF you can prove yourself over time.  If you're looking for the high dollar to start, please don't waste our time...we reward the right candidates once they've shown they deserve it.

13th month bonus, paid time off, performance-based raises

Long-term role — I'm hiring for years, not months





*****

How to Apply

To confirm you actually read this post, start your application and message to me with the phrase: "I read everything very thoroughly and I qualify.";; not just the title of the post, but in the message as well. Applications without it will be skipped.  



Then send:



1. Your resume and a short intro about why this role fits you

2. Thoughtful (anti AI -we'll KNOW!) and genuine answers to these questions:

-Tell me about a time you handled a vendor or client situation start-to-finish without escalating

-Which AI tools do you use weekly, and what specifically do you use them for?

-What's your STR experience? Which platforms, and what did you actually handle?

-Describe in incredible detail, the last time your boss was unavailable and something urgent came up. What did you do, and what did your boss say when they came back?

-Describe in detail how you would handle a task in which you are unsure of how to accomplish step by step.

3. A current 1–2 minute Loom or voice clip introducing yourself in English



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid trial task before a final hire decision.  Important: During the 48 hours you're working on this task, do not contact me with clarifying questions. Make the best judgment calls you can with the information provided and note your assumptions in the deliverable. Part of what I'm evaluating is how you operate when I'm not available to answer.



I read every application personally. Looking forward to meeting you.

IBTimes UK is an international digital news publication covering world news, politics, business, technology, entertainment, lifestyle and trending stories. We publish timely, accurate and engaging journalism for audiences across the UK and internationally.

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.

A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

title: THE MARKETING GENIUS
description:
WANTED: The Marketing Genius 



Think... Scroll-Stopping Creator Meets Funnel-Building Machine



Let's be real for a second. Most marketing job ads want a "social media VA" who schedules posts and calls it a day. This is not that job.



At The Event Engineer, we help visionary entrepreneurs scale past the 7-figure mark by building world-class event systems. We don't do "average," and we don't do generic. We are growing fast, and right now, our founder, Lisa Barry, needs one person to own the entire marketing engine.



We are looking for a rare human who is a 50/50 split between a Brilliant Content Creator and a High-Converting Funnel Builder. If you can write a hook that stops thumbs, edit a Reel that gets shared, AND build the GHL funnel that turns those views into revenue... welcome home.



The Stack You'll Own (Your Playground):

Content That Converts: Reels, TikToks, Shorts, YouTube long-form, and our weekly Substack. You research the trends, write the hooks, direct the edits, and hit publish. Every piece sounds exactly like Lisa, never like a robot.

The Wednesday Drop: Our weekly
 newsletter, yours end to end. Written, designed, built, sent.

GoHighLevel (GHL): You'll build and optimize high-converting landing pages,
 campaigns, and sales funnels. Every page visually stunning, premium, and functional.

Claude (Your AI Bestie): We don't just use AI; we co-work with it. You'll use Claude for copywriting, strategy, and analysis. You are the pilot; Claude is your hyper-intelligent co-pilot. But if your output sounds like AI wrote it, it never gets published.

Canva & Video Editing: You'll look at our analytics, figure out a killer strategy, then actually bring it to life: scroll-stopping short-form videos, lead magnets, PDF guides, and design assets so clean our developer can drop them straight into pages.

The Community: You'll engage with our audience daily and answer comments and DMs in Lisa's voice, building real relationships, not just follower counts.



Who You Are:

An Autonomous Thinker: You don't need a manager breathing down your neck. You see a gap, you engineer a solution, and you execute it.

A Strategic Storyteller: You actually understand marketing psychology. You know why a video went viral or why a funnel converted, and you can repeat that success.

Design-Obsessed: If it looks cheap, it doesn't get published. Period.

A Numbers Person Too: You report on what worked with real data, not vibes.



Qualifications:

2 to 3+ years working with high-ticket coaches, creators, or agencies

Absolute mastery of GoHighLevel, ClickUp, and Canva

Next-level video editing skills (especially short-form Reels/TikToks)

Flawless English and a gift for "voice-matching" (you can write exactly how Lisa talks)

You know how to prompt Claude like an absolute pro to speed up your workflow

lbourne time (Full-Time, matching Aussie hours!)

We want to see the real human behind the screen. If you send us a 100% ChatGPT-generated cover letter, it goes straight to the trash.

The owner wants someone who can work from objectives with little day-to-day management. That means asking the right questions to lock down requirements, designing your own solutions, and delivering results. The right person is good with software, strong at prompt engineering, and able to connect AI tools with the platforms and other tools the company already uses.

 revenue and engagement, and continuously improve performance

Build and maintain clean prospect databases for TMBP's Australian sales team, and research industry trends, competitor activity, new gym openings, and partnership or sponsorship opportunities.

Once the
 lists and lead pipeline are built out, the role will grow into managing paid advertising. This is where the role expands over time, not where it starts.

4. Reporting

 revenue and engagement, lead generation, and cost per lead, plus paid ad performance once campaigns are running. Make clear recommendations for improvement.

 marketing skills. Experience with Klaviyo is a major bonus, but most

, using AI tools to support

• Strong English written communication

• Able to collaborate with and advise the founder on how best to achieve his objectives

title: Amazon Operations Manager (FBA / Seller Central)
description:
Amazon Supply Chain & Operations Manager 

Work: Full-time (remote)

Schedule: US EST Hours



We are looking for a highly capable Amazon Supply Chain & Operations Manager to help lead and run our Amazon USA private label business.



This is a hands-on role that combines team oversight and direct execution. It is roughly 50% manager / 50% individual contributor. We need someone who can lead a small team, make sound operational decisions, and also step in directly to solve issues when needed.



This role sits at the center of our operations — from China supplier production, to freight and customs coordination, to 3PL management, to Amazon FBA inventory flow, to Amazon Seller Central account health and operational issue resolution.



This is not a light coordination role. We are looking for someone who understands Amazon operations deeply and can take real ownership.



What You’ll Be Responsible For

>Oversee end-to-end supply chain and operations for our Amazon USA private label business

>Manage inventory flow from suppliers in China to 3PL warehouses in the USA and into Amazon FBA

>Monitor inventory levels and help prevent both stockouts and excess inventory

>Build, manage, and improve monthly and seasonal demand forecasts

>Support purchasing and replenishment decisions based on sales trends, forecasts, and operational constraints

>Step in directly during critical operational periods to help solve logistics issues, customs clearance problems, inbound delays, or other supply chain disruptions

>Manage Amazon Seller Central operational workflows as needed

>Own or help resolve Amazon account health issues, including policy violations, IP complaints, and compliance-related issues

>Coordinate closely with internal teams so inventory planning stays aligned with PPC and business needs

>Monitor product listings, rankings, and competitor activity to help maintain marketplace competitiveness

>Work with suppliers, freight forwarders, and 3PL partners, including issue escalation when needed

>Oversee purchasing activities and help ensure cost-efficiency, strong execution, and on-time delivery

>Manage and mentor a small operations team of 2–3 people

>Help establish clear processes, KPIs, and accountability across the team

>Contribute to process improvement and support other operational or analytical projects as business needs evolve



What We’re Looking For

1. 3+ years of hands-on experience in Amazon operations, supply chain, or logistics within an Amazon environment

2. Strong experience with Amazon FBA, 3PL operations, and international shipping

3. Solid understanding of China-to-USA supply chain flow, including freight forwarding and customs-related coordination

4. Proven experience in forecasting, inventory planning, and demand analysis

5. Hands-on experience using Amazon Seller Central

6. Experience handling Amazon account health, including policy violations, IP complaints, and compliance issues

7. Strong attention to detail, strong judgment, and the ability to solve issues quickly and calmly

8. Highly organized and process-driven

9. Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-responsibility environment

9. Strong English communication skills

10. Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills

11. Comfortable working U.S. East Coast hours



Nice to Have

Experience launching new products on Amazon

Familiarity with tools like Helium 10, SoStocked, or similar forecasting/software tools

Experience managing a small e-commerce or operations team

Familiarity with ClickUp, Asana, or similar project management tools

Mandarin is a plus for supplier communication





What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means keeping operations running smoothly across supply chain and Amazon execution. 

That includes:

> maintaining healthy inventory levels

>reducing stockouts and overstock

>supporting strong FBA inventory performance

>resolving account health and compliance issues quickly improving forecasting accuracy

>helping the team operate with more clarity, accountability, and consistency



(PLEASE TAKE THOUGHTFUL TIME ANSWERING THIS) 

HOW TO APPLY: SEND YOUR UPDATED CV/RESUME WITH THE ANSWER TO THE SCREENING QUESTIONS BELOW:



1) Do you have direct hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA operations in a private label business? Please explain exactly what you personally owned.

2) What type of Amazon business model did you support: private label, wholesale, agency, aggregator, or other?

3) How many SKUs were under your scope, and what types of products were they?

4) Describe your direct role in forecasting, replenishment, and inventory planning.

5) Have you handled China to USA supply chain, 3PL coordination, or FBA inbound issues? Give one example.

6) Have you personally resolved Amazon account health / policy / IP / compliance issues? Give one real example.

7) Tell us about one operational problem you solved that improved execution, reduced stockouts, or prevented costly errors.

8) What exactly did you use Seller Central for in your day-to-day work?

9) Can you work EST hours?

ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a senior-level Odoo Systems & Process Consultant to help us audit, map and improve complex Odoo workflows across Inventory, Manufacturing, Purchasing, Sales, CRM, Helpdesk and eCommerce.



This is not a simple admin role. We need someone who can understand real operational processes, identify bottlenecks, challenge inefficient workflows, and design practical Odoo solutions that make day-to-day work easier for our team.



Our workflows include multi-stage manufacturing and subcontracting, product variants, raw material resupply to subcontractors, receiving coated and component products, final assembly BoMs, and ensuring Odoo remains aligned with a simple and intuitive Shopify customer ordering experience.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Map and document existing Odoo workflows across Sales, Inventory, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Subcontracting and Customer Support.

• Review complex MRP, BoM, subcontracting and inventory flows and recommend improved system architecture.

• Design streamlined workflows for raw material resupply, subcontractor/coater management, component receipt, final assembly production, labour BoMs and packaging BoMs.

• Simplify product setup using the appropriate combination of product variants, attributes, configuration templates, automated actions and custom development.

• Improve order flexibility so sales users can amend orders after processing without creating inventory, purchasing or manufacturing issues.

• Help align complex back-end processes with a simple and user-friendly Shopify eCommerce experience.

• Document recommended workflows clearly so our internal team can understand, maintain and develop them further.

• Where appropriate, implement or specify Odoo Studio changes, automated actions, server actions, custom fields, views, reporting filters and other user-focused improvements.



EXAMPLES OF ODOO PROCESSES WE NEED TO IMPROVE



• A cleaner product creation process for configurable products with repetitive variant configurations, reducing lengthy manual setup.

• A robust way to handle bespoke and non-returnable products on quotations and orders.

• Better visibility of customer communication preferences within CRM.

• Improved links between Helpdesk Tickets, CRM Opportunities and Sales Orders.

• Inventory alerts and location-based stock counting improvements.

• Enhanced change logs, margin visibility and Shopify-related sales fields.



OUR CURRENT ODOO ENVIRONMENT



We have already completed several successful Odoo customisations, including:



• Linking Helpdesk Tickets to Sales Orders.

• Creating Sales Orders directly from Helpdesk Tickets.

• Linking Helpdesk Tickets with CRM Opportunities.



We are now looking to move into more advanced process architecture around MRP, subcontracting, inventory management and eCommerce integration.



We are also preparing for a future upgrade from Odoo 17 to Odoo 20. This will require thorough review and testing to ensure any existing functionality that may break during the upgrade is identified, documented and resolved before deployment.



Previous upgrades have been disruptive to business operations, so a key objective of this role is to help us:



• Map existing processes and customisations.

• Identify potential upgrade risks.

• Ensure workflows continue working as expected after the upgrade.

• Document any process changes.

• Train users on new or modified workflows before any upgrade takes place.



ADVANCED TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



We operate Odoo Online and prefer standard Odoo functionality wherever possible. However, when a business requirement cannot be achieved using standard functionality, the successful candidate must be confident developing solutions using:



• Odoo Studio

• Automated Actions

• Server Actions

• Python



You should be able to assess a business problem and determine whether it should be solved using standard Odoo functionality, Studio customisation, automation, Python development, or a combination of these approaches.



PYTHON & CUSTOMISATION EXPERIENCE



This is not a purely functional consultant role.



You must be able to demonstrate real examples of Python-based Odoo customisations that you have implemented.



We do not mind whether the code was written entirely by you, created with AI assistance, adapted from existing examples, or developed using tools such as Microsoft Copilot. What matters is that you:



• Understand what the code does.

• Can explain the logic clearly.

• Can troubleshoot and maintain it.

• Can modify and improve it when required.

• Can deliver reliable, working solutions.



Please provide examples involving:



• Python-based workflow automation.

• Odoo Studio customisations.

• Automated Actions and Server Actions.

• Complex field calculations.

• Inventory, manufacturing, procurement or sales workflow improvements.



EFFICIENCY MATTERS



We value simplicity and maintainability.



The best solution is not always the one with the most code.



We expect candidates to:



• Challenge unnecessary complexity.

• Use standard Odoo functionality wherever possible.

• Use Odoo Studio before resorting to custom code where appropriate.

• Write concise, efficient and maintainable code when development is genuinely required.

• Avoid creating hundreds of lines of custom code to solve problems that could be addressed through configuration or standard workflows.



REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience as an Odoo Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Solutions Architect or Senior Odoo Developer.

• Expert understanding of Odoo Manufacturing (MRP), Inventory, Purchasing, Sales and Subcontracting workflows.

• Strong experience mapping complex operational processes into practical ERP workflows.

• Comfortable using Odoo Studio, Automated Actions, Server Actions, Custom Fields, Views and workflow automation.

• Able to explain complex systems clearly to non-technical users.

• Excellent written English and documentation skills.

• Able to work independently, ask the right questions and challenge assumptions when improvements can be made.



NICE TO HAVE



• Experience with Shopify or other eCommerce integrations.

• Experience with Odoo Online and Odoo 17.

• Experience supporting manufacturing, fabrication, procurement, construction supply, distribution or highly configurable product businesses.

• Knowledge of Python, XML and QWeb development.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



• A summary of your experience with Odoo MRP, Inventory, Purchasing and Subcontracting.

• Two or three examples of complex Odoo workflows you have mapped, redesigned or implemented.

• At least two examples of Python-based Odoo customisations, including:

  - The business problem.

  - Why standard Odoo functionality was insufficient.

  - The solution implemented.

  - Approximate amount of code required.

  - The business outcome achieved.

• Your hourly rate in USD.

• Your availability per week.

• Confirmation that you are comfortable working on a pay-as-you-go / project-based basis.



APPLICATION QUESTION



Describe a situation where you deliberately chose a standard Odoo solution instead of writing custom Python code. Why was this the better business decision?

title: YouTube Video Editor Needed for New Fitness / Adventure / Challenge Channel
description:
I am looking for a long-term YouTube video editor to help edit videos for my channel, **IAmLiminal**.



The channel is about growth through action: fitness challenges, travel, trying new things, self-improvement, and adventure-style videos.



Examples of videos I am working on:



* I Trained Like Cristiano Ronaldo Until I Burned 1,000 Calories

* Traveling Solo to the Loneliest Island in the USA

* Learning to Ride a bike as an adult

* I Went to New York for the First Time

* Noob vs One Arm Push-Up

* I Tried Ronaldo’s Free Kick for 100 Attempts



I am looking for someone who can help turn raw footage into entertaining, fast-paced YouTube videos with strong storytelling.



## What I Need Help With



You will help edit long-form YouTube videos, usually around 8–15 minutes.



The editing style should include:



* Strong hook in the first 15–30 seconds

* Good pacing and retention

* Cutting boring moments

* Funny zooms, sound effects, and reactions

* Clean subtitles/captions when needed

* B-roll placement

* Music selection

* Simple motion graphics

* Meme-style edits when appropriate

* Calorie counters, timers, progress bars, or challenge graphics

* Smooth storytelling from beginning to end



I do not want basic editing where clips are just placed together.



I need someone who understands how to make a video entertaining, WHILE telling a story.



## Ideal Candidate



You are a good fit if:



* You understand YouTube pacing and retention

* You can edit challenge, fitness, travel, or vlog-style videos

* You can make videos funny without over-editing

* You are creative and can make suggestions

* You pay attention to story, not just visuals

* You are reliable and communicate clearly

* You can meet deadlines

* You are interested in a long-term working relationship



## Editing Style References



The style should feel like a mix of:



* Fitness challenge videos

* Travel/adventure vlogs

* Ryan Trahan-style storytelling

* Biaheza-style humor/pacing

* YouTube challenge videos with clean editing and personality



I do not want the videos to feel corporate or boring.



They should feel fun, energetic, and personal.



## Workload



This will start with 1 video as a test project.



If it goes well, I want to work together long-term on:



* 2–4 long-form videos per month

* 12-15 Shorts/Reels/TikToks from the long-form videos per month



## Requirements



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your video editing portfolio

2. Examples of YouTube videos you have edited

3. Your expected rate per 8–15 minute video

4. Your turnaround time for one video

5. What editing software you use

6. A short explanation of how you would make a fitness challenge video entertaining



To show that you read the full post, start your application with the word:



**LIMINAL**



Applications that do not start with this word will not be considered.



## Bonus Skills



These are not required, but they are a plus:



* Thumbnail design

* Short-form editing

* Motion graphics

* Sound design

* Color correction

* Experience editing fitness, travel, or challenge videos



## Test Project



For the first project, I will provide raw footage, a rough outline, and notes.



Your job will be to create a polished YouTube video that is entertaining, well-paced, and tells a clear story.



If the test project goes well, this can become a long-term role.

title: Technical Billing Coordinator
description:
The Technical Billing Coordinator (Timely Expert) is responsible for overseeing, auditing, and automating ancillary and addendum billing processes to ensure every billable hour and service is accurately captured, verified, and invoiced. This position serves as the company’s expert on time-tracking and billing accuracy—primarily through Timely—and collaborates closely with the Accounting and IT departments to streamline processes, enhance automation, and maximize captured revenue.



The role focuses on improving billing precision, reducing missed opportunities, and ensuring that all billing aligns with management agreement terms across the company’s portfolio.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Timely Auditing & Oversight:

- Review all employee Timely entries weekly to ensure accuracy and compliance with HOA management agreements.

- Identify unbilled, misclassified, or duplicate entries and coordinate corrections with staff.

- Maintain an updated billing reference guide for each property, outlining contract inclusions, exclusions, and special billing parameters.

- Track and report Timely utilization rates, identifying patterns of under- or over-capture.



2. Ancillary Billing Automation:

- Develop and maintain automation processes for addendum services such as maintenance, inspections, resale packages, and other billable items.

- Collaborate with the IT department to integrate Timely data into accounting and billing systems for seamless invoicing and reconciliation.

- Partner with Accounting to ensure all ancillary billings are properly reflected in monthly financial statements.

- Recommend and implement system enhancements to improve billing accuracy and reduce manual workload.



3. Revenue Analysis & Reporting:

- Generate weekly and monthly reports summarizing billing accuracy, capture rates, and financial impact.

- Analyze data to identify missed billing opportunities or recurring discrepancies.

- Provide actionable recommendations to Accounting and Operations for training, policy updates, or process improvements.

- Support leadership with data-driven insights into revenue trends and performance.



4. Contract Compliance:

- Ensure all billing aligns with each community’s management agreement and addenda.

- Review new and existing contracts to identify billable triggers and automation opportunities.

- Collaborate with Accounting and Operations to interpret billing terms and resolve ambiguities.



5. Collaboration & Support:

- Serve as the company’s subject matter expert on Timely usage and best practices.

- Work closely with Accounting and IT to design and test billing automations.

- Provide guidance and training to staff to improve billing accuracy and consistency.

- Support leadership in developing future regional audit and optimization programs.



Qualifications:

- Proven experience in billing audit, revenue management, or time-tracking oversight, preferably within property management, accounting, or professional services.

- Strong understanding of time-tracking platforms (Timely, Harvest, or similar).

- Experience with contract-based billing models and interpreting service agreements.

- Skilled in Excel, reporting tools, and system integrations.

- Analytical, detail-oriented, and capable of identifying inefficiencies and process gaps.

- Excellent communication and organizational skills.

- Ability to collaborate effectively with Accounting, IT, and Operations teams.



Performance Metrics:

- Increase in captured billable hours.

- Reduction in billing discrepancies and adjustments.

- Improved Timely utilization and accuracy rates.

- Efficiency gains through automation and process improvement.

- Reduction in staff time spent on manual billing corrections.



Growth Opportunity:

This position will begin as a pilot role focused on optimizing billing processes and automation. Based on measurable success in billing accuracy and revenue improvement, the Revenue Optimization Coordinator will help develop and oversee broader regional auditing and automation initiatives across The Nabo Group.



Working Conditions:

- This is a fully remote position — work from anywhere.

- Must be available to work during Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours, Monday – Friday.

- Use of Hubstaff time-tracking software is required during working hours.
